hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Repeatedly combine the two smallest elements until all elements are at least k.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: A min heap provides logarithmic retrieval and insertion of combined elements.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Heapify nums. While heap length is at least 2 and heap root is less than k, pop two smallest values x and y, and push min(x, y) * 2 + max(x, y).

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minOperations(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        import heapq
        heapq.heapify(nums)
        ops = 0
        while len(nums) >= 2 and nums[0] < k:
            x = heapq.heappop(nums)
            y = heapq.heappop(nums)
            heapq.heappush(nums, x * 2 + y)
            ops += 1
        return ops
```

complexity.notes: At most n operations, each taking logarithmic time on min-heap.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the array after every combination takes O(n^2 log n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a min-heap priority queue to greedily extract the two smallest elements.
